positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is lower triangular\n\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // A is stored in row-major order\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            \n            if (i == j) {\n                // Diagonal element\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                    sum += A[j * n + k] * A[j * n + k];\n                }\n                const double val = A[j * n + j] - sum;\n                if (val <= 0.0) {\n                    // Matrix is not positive definite\n                    printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n                    return false;\n                }\n                A[j * n + j] = sqrt(val);\n            } else {\n                // Off-diagonal element\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                    sum += A[i * n + k] * A[j * n + k];\n                }\n                A[i * n + j] = (A[i * n + j] - sum) / A[j * n + j];\n            }\n        }\n        \n        // Zero out upper triangular part\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            A[i * n + j] = 0.0;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n    \n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    \n    // Generate random matrix B\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n    \n    // Compute A = B * B^T\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += B[i * n + k] * B[j * n + k];\n            }\n            A[i * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i * n + i] += n;\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig, const size_t n) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n    \n    std::vector<double> reconstructed(n * n);\n    \n    // Compute L * L^T\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += L[i * n + k] * L[j * n + k];\n            }\n            reconstructed[i * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Compare with original\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n    \n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        const double error = fabs(reconstructed[i] - A_orig[i]);\n        maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n        \n        const double rel = error / (fabs(A_orig[i]) + 1e-10);\n        relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n    printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n    \n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    // Allocate matrix\n    std::vector<double> A(n * n);\n    std::vector<double> A_orig;\n    \n    // Generate positive decomposition (sequential, unblocked algorithm)\n// Decomposes positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is lower triangular\n\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // A is stored in row-major order\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            \n            if (i == j) {\n Accumulation runs over increasing k with one\n// accumulator per (i, jj), matching the sequential summation order exactly.\ntemplate <size_t M>\ninline void gemmTile(const double* __restrict Ap, const size_t n, const double* __restrict Bt,\n                     double* __restrict S, const size_t i0, const size_t J, const size_t jbPad) {\n#ifdef CHOLESKY_USE_AVX2\n    for (size_t jt = 0; // padding lanes must not carry stale data\n                }\n            }\n            #pragma omp barrier\n\n            // --- Panel GEMM: leading part (k < J) of every remaining element ---\n            const size_t rows = n - J;\n            const size_t nTiles = rows / MI;\n            #pragma omp for schedule(static)\n            for (size_t t = 0; t < nTiles; ++t) {\n                gemmTile<MI>(Ap, n, Bt, S, J + t * MI, J, jbPad);\n            }\n            #pragma omp single\n            {\n                for (size_t i = J + nTiles * MI; i < n; // column block width\nconstexpr size_t MI = 6;  // rows handled per GEMM register tile\nconstexpr size_t NV = 8;  // columns handled per GEMM register tile (2 AVX2 vectors)\n\n// Computes S[i][jj] = sum_{k<J} A[i][k] * Bt[k][jj] for M consecutive rows i,\n// where Bt[k][jj] = L[J+jj][k] is the transposed (k-contiguous -> jj-contiguous)\n// panel of the block columns. Accumulation runs over increasing k with one\n// accumulator per (i, jj), matching the sequential summation order exactly.\ntemplate <size_t M>\ninline void gemmTile(const double* __restrict Ap, const size_t n, const double* __restrict Bt,\n                     double* __restrict S, const size_t i0, const size_t J, const size_t jbPad) {\n#ifdef CHOLESKY_USE_AVX2\n    for (size_t jt = 0; jt < jbPad; jt += NV) {\n        __m256d acc0[M], acc1[M];\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n            acc0[m] = _mm256_setzero_pd();\n            acc1[m] = _mm256_setzero_pd();\n        }\n        const double* bt = Bt + jt;\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < J; ++k, bt += JB) {\n            const __m256d b0 = _mm256_loadu_pd(bt);\n            const __m256d b1 = _mm256_loadu_pd(bt + 4);\n            for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n                const __m256d a = _mm256_set1_pd(Ap[(i0 + m) * n + k]);\n                acc0[m] = _mm256_fmadd_pd(a, b0, acc0[m]);\n                acc1[m] = _mm256_fmadd_pd(a, b1, acc1[m]);\n            }\n        }\n        for (size_t m = 0; jt += NV) {\n        double acc[M][NV] = {};\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < J; ++k) {\n            for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n                const double a = Ap[(i0 + m) * n + k];\n                for (size_t v = 0; v < NV; ++v) {\n                    acc[m][v] += a * Bt[k * JB + jt + v];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n            for (size_t v = 0; v < NV; ++v) {\n                S[(i0 + m) * JB + jt + v] = acc[m][v];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n#endif\n}\n\n} // namespace\n\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // A is stored in row-major order\n    if (n == 0) {\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    double* const __restrict Ap = A.data();\n    // Bt[k * JB + jj] = L[J + jj][k]: transposed panel of the active block columns.\n    std::vector<double> BtStore(n * JB, 0.0);\n    // S[i * JB + jj]: partial sum over k < J for element (i, J + jj).\n    std::vector<double> SStore(n * JB, 0.0);\n    double* const __restrict Bt = BtStore.data();\n    double* const __restrict S = SStore.data();\n\n    bool ok = true;\n\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        for (size_t J = 0; // padding lanes must not carry stale data\n                }\n            }\n            #pragma omp barrier\n\n            // --- Panel GEMM: leading part (k < J) of every remaining element ---\n            const size_t nTiles = (n - J + MI - 1) / MI;\n            #pragma omp for schedule(static)\n            for (size_t t = 0; t < nTiles; ++t) {\n                const size_t i0 = J + t * MI;\n                switch (std::min(MI, n - i0)) {\n                    case 6: gemmTile<6>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, J, jbPad); break;\n                    case 5: gemmTile<5>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, J, jbPad); break;\n                    case 4: gemmTile<4>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, J, jbPad); break;\n                    case 3: gemmTile<3>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, J, jbPad); break;\n                    case 2: gemmTile<2>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, J, jbPad); Accumulation runs over increasing k with one\n// accumulator per (i, jj), matching the sequential summation order exactly.\ntemplate <size_t M>\ninline void gemmTile(const double* __restrict Ap, const size_t n, const double* __restrict Bt,\n                     double* __restrict S, const size_t i0, const size_t J, const size_t jbPad) {\n#ifdef CHOLESKY_USE_AVX2\n    for (size_t jt = 0; ++v) {\n                S[(i0 + m) * JB + jt + v] = acc[m][v];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n#endif\n}\n\n} // namespace\n\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // A is stored in row-major order\n    if (n == 0) {\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    double* const __restrict Ap = A.data();\n    // Bt[k * JB + jj] = L[J + jj][k]: transposed panel of the active block columns.\n    std::vector<double> BtStore(n * JB, 0.0);\n    // S[i * JB + jj]: partial sum over k < J for element (i, J + jj).\n    std::vector<double> SStore(n * JB, 0.0);\n    double* const __restrict Bt = BtStore.data();\n    double* const __restrict S = SStore.data();\n\n    bool ok = true;\n\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        for (size_t J = 0; t < nTiles; ++t) {\n                const size_t i0 = J + t * MI;\n                switch (std::min(MI, n - i0)) {\n                    case 6: gemmTile<6>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, J, jbPad); break;\n                    case 5: gemmTile<5>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, J, jbPad); Thread migration between cores (and\n// especially between NUMA nodes) costs an order of magnitude here, and the\n// benchmark is usually launched without OMP_PROC_BIND set. An explicit binding\n// policy from the environment always wins.\nvoid bindThreads() {\n#ifdef __linux__\n    if (omp_get_proc_bind() != omp_proc_bind_false || getenv(\"GOMP_CPU_AFFINITY\") != nullptr) {\n        return;\n    }\n    cpu_set_t allowed;\n    CPU_ZERO(&allowed);\n    if (sched_getaffinity(0, sizeof(allowed), &allowed) != 0) {\n        return;\n    }\n    std::vector<int> cpus;\n    for (int c = 0; c < CPU_SETSIZE; ++c) {\n        if (CPU_ISSET(c, &allowed)) {\n            cpus.push_back(c);\n        }\n    }\n    if (cpus.empty()) {\n        return;\n    }\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        cpu_set_t set;\n        CPU_ZERO(&set);\n        CPU_SET(cpus[static_cast<size_t>(omp_get_thread_num()) % cpus.size()], &set);\n        sched_setaffinity(0, sizeof(set), &set);\n    }\n#endif\n}\n\nconstexpr size_t JB = 64; // column block width\nconstexpr size_t MI = 6;  // rows handled per GEMM register tile\nconstexpr size_t NV = 8;  // columns handled per GEMM register tile (2 AVX2 vectors)\n\n// Computes S[i][jj] = sum_{k<J} A[i][k] * Bt[k][jj] for M consecutive rows i,\n// where Bt[k][jj] = L[J+jj][k] is the transposed (k-contiguous -> jj-contiguous)\n// panel of the block columns. Accumulation runs over increasing k with one\n// accumulator per (i, jj), matching the sequential summation order exactly.\ntemplate <size_t M>\ninline void gemmTile(const double* __restrict Ap, const size_t n, const double* __restrict Bt,\n                     double* __restrict S, const size_t i0, const size_t J, const size_t jbPad) {\n#ifdef CHOLESKY_USE_AVX2\n    for (size_t jt = 0; jt < jbPad; jt += NV) {\n        __m256d acc0[M], acc1[M];\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n            acc0[m] = _mm256_setzero_pd();\n            acc1[m] = _mm256_setzero_pd();\n        }\n        const double* bt = Bt + jt;\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < J; ++k, bt += JB) {\n            const __m256d b0 = _mm256_loadu_pd(bt);\n            const __m256d b1 = _mm256_loadu_pd(bt + 4);\n            for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n                const __m256d a = _mm256_set1_pd(Ap[(i0 + m) * n + k]);\n                acc0[m] = _mm256_fmadd_pd(a, b0, acc0[m]);\n                acc1[m] = _mm256_fmadd_pd(a, b1, acc1[m]);\n            }\n        }\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n            _mm256_storeu_pd(S + (i0 + m) * JB + jt, acc0[m]);\n            _mm256_storeu_pd(S + (i0 + m) * JB + jt + 4, acc1[m]);\n        }\n    }\n#else\n    for (size_t jt = 0; jt < jbPad; jt += NV) {\n        double acc[M][NV] = {};\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < J; ++k) {\n            for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n                const double a = Ap[(i0 + m) * n + k];\n                for (size_t v = 0; v < NV; ++v) {\n                    acc[m][v] += a * Bt[k * JB + jt + v];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n            for (size_t v = 0; v < NV; ++v) {\n                S[(i0 + m) * JB + jt + v] = acc[m][v];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n#endif\n}\n\n} // namespace\n\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // A is stored in row-major order\n    if (n == 0) {\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    double* const __restrict Ap = A.data();\n    // Bt[k * JB + jj] = L[J + jj][k]: transposed panel of the active block columns.\n    std::vector<double> BtStore(n * JB, 0.0);\n    // S[i * JB + jj]: partial sum over k < J for element (i, J + jj).\n    std::vector<double> SStore(n * JB, 0.0);\n    double* const __restrict Bt = BtStore.data();\n    double* const __restrict S = SStore.data();\n\n    bool ok = true;\n\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        for (size_t J = 0; J < n; J += JB) {\n            const size_t jb = std::min(JB, n - J);\n            const size_t jbPad = (jb + NV - 1) / NV * NV;\n\n            // --- Transpose the block-column panel of the already computed part ---\n            #pragma omp for schedule(static) nowait\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < J; ++k) {\n                for (size_t jj = 0; jj < jb; ++jj) {\n                    Bt[k * JB + jj] = Ap[(J + jj) * n + k];\n                }\n                for (size_t jj = jb; jj < jbPad; ++jj) {\n                    Bt[k * JB + jj] = 0.0; // padding lanes must not carry stale data\n                }\n            }\n            #pragma omp barrier\n\n            // --- Panel GEMM: leading part (k < J) of every remaining element ---\n            const size_t nTiles = (n - J + MI - 1) / MI;\n            #pragma omp for schedule(static)\n            for (size_t t = 0; t < nTiles; ++t) {\n                const size_t i0 = J + t * MI;\n                switch (std::min(MI, n - i0)) {\n                    case 6: gemmTile<6>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, J, jbPad); break;\n                    case 5: gemmTile<5>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, J, jbPad); break;\n                    case 4: gemmTile<4>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, J, jbPad); break;\n                    case 3: gemmTile<3>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, J, jbPad); break;\n                    case 2: gemmTile<2>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, J, jbPad); break;\n                    default: gemmTile<1>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, J, jbPad); break;\n                }\n            }\n            #pragma omp single\n            {\n                // --- Factor the diagonal block sequentially (O(jb^3) work) ---\n                for (size_t j = J; j < J + jb; ++j) {\n                    const double* const Aj = Ap + j * n;\n                    double sum = S[j * JB + (j - J)];\n                    for (size_t k = J; k < j; ++k) {\n                        sum += Aj[k] * Aj[k];\n                    }\n                    const double val = Aj[j] - sum;\n                    if (val <= 0.0) {\n                        // Matrix is not positive definite\n                        printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n                        ok = false;\n                        break;\n                    }\n                    Ap[j * n + j] = sqrt(val);\n\n                    const double djj = Ap[j * n + j];\n                    for (size_t i = j + 1; i < J + jb; ++i) {\n                        double* const Ai = Ap + i * n;\n                        double s = S[i * JB + (j - J)];\n                        for (size_t k = J; k < j; ++k) {\n                            s += Ai[k] * Aj[k];\n                        }\n                        Ai[j] = (Ai[j] - s) / djj;\n                    }\n                }\n            } // implicit barrier: publishes ok and the diagonal block\n\n            if (!ok) {\n                break;\n            }\n\n            // --- Triangular solve for the rows below the diagonal block ---\n            const size_t iStart = J + jb;\n            const size_t nQuads = (n - iStart) / 4;\n            #pragma omp for schedule(static)\n            for (size_t q = 0; q < nQuads; ++q) {\n                const size_t i0 = iStart + q * 4;\n                double* const A0 = Ap + i0 * n;\n                double* const A1 = A0 + n;\n                double* const A2 = A0 + 2 * n;\n                double* const A3 = A0 + 3 * n;\n                const double* const S0 = S + i0 * JB;\n                for (size_t j = J; j < J + jb; ++j) {\n                    const double* const Aj = Ap + j * n;\n                    const size_t jj = j - J;\n                    double s0 = S0[jj];\n                    double s1 = S0[JB + jj];\n                    double s2 = S0[2 * JB + jj];\n                    double s3 = S0[3 * JB + jj];\n                    for (size_t k = J; k < j; ++k) {\n                        const double b = Aj[k];\n                        s0 += A0[k] * b;\n                        s1 += A1[k] * b;\n                        s2 += A2[k] * b;\n                        s3 += A3[k] * b;\n                    }\n                    const double djj = Aj[j];\n                    A0[j] = (A0[j] - s0) / djj;\n                    A1[j] = (A1[j] - s1) / djj;\n                    A2[j] = (A2[j] - s2) / djj;\n                    A3[j] = (A3[j] - s3) / djj;\n                }\n            }\n            #pragma omp for schedule(static)\n            for (size_t i = iStart + nQuads * 4; i < n; ++i) {\n                double* const Ai = Ap + i * n;\n                for (size_t j = J; j < J + jb; ++j) {\n                    const double* const Aj = Ap + j * n;\n                    double s = S[i * JB + (j - J)];\n                    for (size_t k = J; k < j; ++k) {\n                        s += Ai[k] * Aj[k];\n                    }\n                    Ai[j] = (Ai[j] - s) / Aj[j];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // --- Zero out upper triangular part ---\n        if (ok) {\n            #pragma omp for schedule(static)\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n                for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n                    Ap[i * n + j] = 0.0;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return ok;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n    \n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    \n    // Generate random matrix B\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n    \n    // Compute A = B * B^T (rows are independent; the k-order of every dot\n    // product is preserved, so the generated matrix is bit-identical)\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        const double* const Bi = B.data() + i * n;\n        double* const Ai = A.data() + i * n;\n        size_t j = 0;\n        for (; j + 4 <= n; j += 4) {\n            const double* const B0 = B.data() + j * n;\n            double s0 = 0.0, s1 = 0.0, s2 = 0.0, s3 = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                const double a = Bi[k];\n                s0 += a * B0[k];\n                s1 += a * B0[n + k];\n                s2 += a * B0[2 * n + k];\n                s3 += a * B0[3 * n + k];\n            }\n            Ai[j] = s0;\n            Ai[j + 1] = s1;\n            Ai[j + 2] = s2;\n            Ai[j + 3] = s3;\n        }\n        for (; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += Bi[k] * B[j * n + k];\n            }\n            Ai[j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i * n + i] += n;\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig, const size_t n) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n    \n    std::vector<double> reconstructed(n * n);\n\n    // Compute L * L^T\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        const double* const Li = L.data() + i * n;\n        double* const Ri = reconstructed.data() + i * n;\n        size_t j = 0;\n        for (; j + 4 <= n; j += 4) {\n            const double* const L0 = L.data() + j * n;\n            double s0 = 0.0, s1 = 0.0, s2 = 0.0, s3 = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                const double a = Li[k];\n                s0 += a * L0[k];\n                s1 += a * L0[n + k];\n                s2 += a * L0[2 * n + k];\n                s3 += a * L0[3 * n + k];\n            }\n            Ri[j] = s0;\n            Ri[j + 1] = s1;\n            Ri[j + 2] = s2;\n            Ri[j + 3] = s3;\n        }\n        for (; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += Li[k] * L[j * n + k];\n            }\n            Ri[j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Compare with original\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(max : maxError, relError)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        const double error = fabs(reconstructed[i] - A_orig[i]);\n        maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n\n        const double rel = error / (fabs(A_orig[i]) + 1e-10);\n        relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n    printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n    \n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", n, n);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    // Allocate matrix\n    std::vector<double> A(n * n);\n    std::vector<double> A_orig;\n    \n    // Generate positive definite matrix\n    printf(\"Generating positive definite matrix...\\n\");\n    generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(A, n);\n    \n    if (validate) {\n        A_orig = A; // Save original for validation\n    }\n    \n    // Perform Cholesky decomposition\n    printf(\"Computing Cholesky decomposition...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    bool success = choleskyDecomposition(A, n);\n    \n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n    \n    if (!success) {\n        printf(\"Cholesky decomposition failed\\n\");\n        return 1;\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n    \n    // Calculate GFLOPS (approximately n³/3 operations for Cholesky)\n    double ops = (double)n * n * n / 3.0;\n    double gflops = ops / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n    printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    \n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        print_results(A, \"CholeskyL\");\n    }\n    \n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        bool valid = validateCholesky(A, A_orig, n);\n        \n        if (valid) {\n            printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return 0;\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":403,"oldLines":6,"newStart":403,"newLines":8,"lines":["         }","     }","     ","+    bindThreads();","+","     printf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");","     printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", n, n);","     printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

Equivalent to running under `numactl --interleave=all`.\nvoid interleaveMemory() {\n#if defined(__linux__) && defined(SYS_set_mempolicy) && defined(SYS_get_mempolicy)\n    constexpr int MPOL_DEFAULT_MODE = 0;\n    constexpr int MPOL_INTERLEAVE_MODE = 3;\n    constexpr unsigned long MPOL_F_MEMS_ALLOWED_FLAG = 1 << 2;\n    constexpr unsigned long MAX_NODES = 1024;\n\n    int mode = 0;\n    if (syscall(SYS_get_mempolicy, &mode, nullptr, 0UL, nullptr, 0UL) != 0 || mode != MPOL_DEFAULT_MODE) {\n        return; // an explicit policy (e.g. from numactl) is already in effect\n    }\n    std::vector<unsigned long> mask(MAX_NODES / (8 * sizeof(unsigned long)), 0UL);\n    if (syscall(SYS_get_mempolicy, nullptr, mask.data(), MAX_NODES, nullptr, MPOL_F_MEMS_ALLOWED_FLAG) != 0) {\n        return;\n    }\n    syscall(SYS_set_mempolicy, MPOL_INTERLEAVE_MODE, mask.data(), MAX_NODES);\n#endif\n}\n\n// Pin each OpenMP thread to its own CPU."},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":389,"cache_read_input_tokens":71492,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":389},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"efb50a90-2147-4834-a3ac-7d5787197574","uuid":"1b777fc2-af51-42c5-84b5-49b2265b8648","timestamp":"2026-09-06T19:44:45.545Z","request_id":"req_011CenkxkJrBxisyUWgTyRpb"}

The matrix is streamed by every\n// thread during the panel updates, so a single-node placement (the default,\n// since std::vector zero-initializes the storage from one thread) would starve\n// the remote socket. Equivalent to running under `numactl --interleave=all`.\nvoid interleaveMemory() {\n#if defined(__linux__) && defined(SYS_set_mempolicy) && defined(SYS_get_mempolicy)\n    constexpr int MPOL_DEFAULT_MODE = 0;\n    constexpr int MPOL_INTERLEAVE_MODE = 3;\n    constexpr unsigned long MPOL_F_MEMS_ALLOWED_FLAG = 1 << 2;\n    constexpr unsigned long MAX_NODES = 1024;\n\n    int mode = 0;\n    if (syscall(SYS_get_mempolicy, &mode, nullptr, 0UL, nullptr, 0UL) != 0 || mode != MPOL_DEFAULT_MODE) {\n        return; // an explicit policy (e.g. from numactl) is already in effect\n    }\n    std::vector<unsigned long> mask(MAX_NODES / (8 * sizeof(unsigned long)), 0UL);\n    if (syscall(SYS_get_mempolicy, nullptr, mask.data(), MAX_NODES, nullptr, MPOL_F_MEMS_ALLOWED_FLAG) != 0) {\n        return;\n    }\n    syscall(SYS_set_mempolicy, MPOL_INTERLEAVE_MODE, mask.data(), MAX_NODES);\n#endif\n}\n\n// Pin each OpenMP thread to its own CPU.","originalFile":"#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <omp.h>\n#include <sched.h>\n\n#if defined(__AVX2__) && defined(__FMA__)\n#include <immintrin.h>\n#define CHOLESKY_USE_AVX2 1\n#endif\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Blocked, OpenMP-parallel Cholesky decomposition (left-looking).\n// Decomposes positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is lower triangular.\n//\n// Every element L[i][j] is still computed as\n//     L[i][j] = (A[i][j] - sum_{k<j} L[i][k]*L[j][k]) / L[j][j]\n// with the summation carried out in strictly increasing k order into a single\n// accumulator, so the results are bit-identical to the sequential version.\n// The sum is only *split* at a block boundary J: the leading part (k < J) is\n// computed by a parallel panel-GEMM into S[][], and the trailing part\n// (J <= k < j) continues to accumulate into that very same value.\n\nnamespace {\n\n// Pin each OpenMP thread to its own CPU. Thread migration between cores (and\n// especially between NUMA nodes) costs an order of magnitude here, and the\n// benchmark is usually launched without OMP_PROC_BIND set. An explicit binding\n// policy from the environment always wins.\nvoid bindThreads() {\n#ifdef __linux__\n    if (omp_get_proc_bind() != omp_proc_bind_false || getenv(\"GOMP_CPU_AFFINITY\") != nullptr) {\n        return;\n    }\n    cpu_set_t allowed;\n    CPU_ZERO(&allowed);\n    if (sched_getaffinity(0, sizeof(allowed), &allowed) != 0) {\n        return;\n    }\n    std::vector<int> cpus;\n    for (int c = 0; c < CPU_SETSIZE; ++c) {\n        if (CPU_ISSET(c, &allowed)) {\n            cpus.push_back(c);\n        }\n    }\n    if (cpus.empty()) {\n        return;\n    }\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        cpu_set_t set;\n        CPU_ZERO(&set);\n        CPU_SET(cpus[static_cast<size_t>(omp_get_thread_num()) % cpus.size()], &set);\n        sched_setaffinity(0, sizeof(set), &set);\n    }\n#endif\n}\n\nconstexpr size_t JB = 64; // column block width\nconstexpr size_t MI = 6;  // rows handled per GEMM register tile\nconstexpr size_t NV = 8;  // columns handled per GEMM register tile (2 AVX2 vectors)\n\n// Computes S[i][jj] = sum_{k<J} A[i][k] * Bt[k][jj] for M consecutive rows i,\n// where Bt[k][jj] = L[J+jj][k] is the transposed (k-contiguous -> jj-contiguous)\n// panel of the block columns. Accumulation runs over increasing k with one\n// accumulator per (i, jj), matching the sequential summation order exactly.\ntemplate <size_t M>\ninline void gemmTile(const double* __restrict Ap, const size_t n, const double* __restrict Bt,\n                     double* __restrict S, const size_t i0, const size_t J, const size_t jbPad) {\n#ifdef CHOLESKY_USE_AVX2\n    for (size_t jt = 0; jt < jbPad; jt += NV) {\n        __m256d acc0[M], acc1[M];\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n            acc0[m] = _mm256_setzero_pd();\n            acc1[m] = _mm256_setzero_pd();\n        }\n        const double* bt = Bt + jt;\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < J; ++k, bt += JB) {\n            const __m256d b0 = _mm256_loadu_pd(bt);\n            const __m256d b1 = _mm256_loadu_pd(bt + 4);\n            for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n                const __m256d a = _mm256_set1_pd(Ap[(i0 + m) * n + k]);\n                acc0[m] = _mm256_fmadd_pd(a, b0, acc0[m]);\n                acc1[m] = _mm256_fmadd_pd(a, b1, acc1[m]);\n            }\n        }\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n            _mm256_storeu_pd(S + (i0 + m) * JB + jt, acc0[m]);\n            _mm256_storeu_pd(S + (i0 + m) * JB + jt + 4, acc1[m]);\n        }\n    }\n#else\n    for (size_t jt = 0; jt < jbPad; jt += NV) {\n        double acc[M][NV] = {};\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < J; ++k) {\n            for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n                const double a = Ap[(i0 + m) * n + k];\n                for (size_t v = 0; v < NV; ++v) {\n                    acc[m][v] += a * Bt[k * JB + jt + v];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n            for (size_t v = 0; v < NV; ++v) {\n                S[(i0 + m) * JB + jt + v] = acc[m][v];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n#endif\n}\n\n} // namespace\n\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // A is stored in row-major order\n    if (n == 0) {\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    double* const __restrict Ap = A.data();\n    // Bt[k * JB + jj] = L[J + jj][k]: transposed panel of the active block columns.\n    std::vector<double> BtStore(n * JB, 0.0);\n    // S[i * JB + jj]: partial sum over k < J for element (i, J + jj).\n    std::vector<double> SStore(n * JB, 0.0);\n    double* const __restrict Bt = BtStore.data();\n    double* const __restrict S = SStore.data();\n\n    bool ok = true;\n\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        for (size_t J = 0; The matrix is streamed by every\n// thread during the panel updates, so a single-node placement (the default,\n// since std::vector zero-initializes the storage from one thread) would starve\n// the remote socket. Equivalent to running under `numactl --interleave=all`.\nvoid interleaveMemory() {\n#if defined(__linux__) && defined(SYS_set_mempolicy) && defined(SYS_get_mempolicy)\n    constexpr int MPOL_DEFAULT_MODE = 0;\n    constexpr int MPOL_INTERLEAVE_MODE = 3;\n    constexpr unsigned long MPOL_F_MEMS_ALLOWED_FLAG = 1 << 2;\n    constexpr unsigned long MAX_NODES = 1024;\n\n    int mode = 0;\n    if (syscall(SYS_get_mempolicy, &mode, nullptr, 0UL, nullptr, 0UL) != 0 || mode != MPOL_DEFAULT_MODE) {\n        return; // an explicit policy (e.g. from numactl) is already in effect\n    }\n    std::vector<unsigned long> mask(MAX_NODES / (8 * sizeof(unsigned long)), 0UL);\n    if (syscall(SYS_get_mempolicy, nullptr, mask.data(), MAX_NODES, nullptr, MPOL_F_MEMS_ALLOWED_FLAG) != 0) {\n        return;\n    }\n    syscall(SYS_set_mempolicy, MPOL_INTERLEAVE_MODE, mask.data(), MAX_NODES);\n#endif\n}\n\n// Pin each OpenMP thread to its own CPU. Thread migration between cores (and\n// especially between NUMA nodes) costs an order of magnitude here, and the\n// benchmark is usually launched without OMP_PROC_BIND set. An explicit binding\n// policy from the environment always wins.\nvoid bindThreads() {\n#ifdef __linux__\n    if (omp_get_proc_bind() != omp_proc_bind_false || getenv(\"GOMP_CPU_AFFINITY\") != nullptr) {\n        return;\n    }\n    cpu_set_t allowed;\n    CPU_ZERO(&allowed);\n    if (sched_getaffinity(0, sizeof(allowed), &allowed) != 0) {\n        return;\n    }\n    std::vector<int> cpus;\n    for (int c = 0; c < CPU_SETSIZE; ++c) {\n        if (CPU_ISSET(c, &allowed)) {\n            cpus.push_back(c);\n        }\n    }\n    if (cpus.empty()) {\n        return;\n    }\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        cpu_set_t set;\n        CPU_ZERO(&set);\n        CPU_SET(cpus[static_cast<size_t>(omp_get_thread_num()) % cpus.size()], &set);\n        sched_setaffinity(0, sizeof(set), &set);\n    }\n#endif\n}\n\n#ifndef CHOL_JB\n#define CHOL_JB 64\n#endif\nconstexpr size_t JB = CHOL_JB; // column block width\nconstexpr size_t MI = 6;  // rows handled per GEMM register tile\nconstexpr size_t NV = 8;  // columns handled per GEMM register tile (2 AVX2 vectors)\n\n// Computes S[i][jj] = sum_{k<J} A[i][k] * Bt[k][jj] for M consecutive rows i,\n// where Bt[k][jj] = L[J+jj][k] is the transposed (k-contiguous -> jj-contiguous)\n// panel of the block columns. Accumulation runs over increasing k with one\n// accumulator per (i, jj), matching the sequential summation order exactly.\ntemplate <size_t M>\ninline void gemmTile(const double* __restrict Ap, const size_t n, const double* __restrict Bt,\n                     double* __restrict S, const size_t i0, const size_t J, const size_t jbPad) {\n#ifdef CHOLESKY_USE_AVX2\n    for (size_t jt = 0; jt < jbPad; jt += NV) {\n        __m256d acc0[M], acc1[M];\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n            acc0[m] = _mm256_setzero_pd();\n            acc1[m] = _mm256_setzero_pd();\n        }\n        const double* bt = Bt + jt;\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < J; ++k, bt += JB) {\n            const __m256d b0 = _mm256_loadu_pd(bt);\n            const __m256d b1 = _mm256_loadu_pd(bt + 4);\n            for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n                const __m256d a = _mm256_set1_pd(Ap[(i0 + m) * n + k]);\n                acc0[m] = _mm256_fmadd_pd(a, b0, acc0[m]);\n                acc1[m] = _mm256_fmadd_pd(a, b1, acc1[m]);\n            }\n        }\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n            _mm256_storeu_pd(S + (i0 + m) * JB + jt, acc0[m]);\n            _mm256_storeu_pd(S + (i0 + m) * JB + jt + 4, acc1[m]);\n        }\n    }\n#else\n    for (size_t jt = 0; jt < jbPad; jt += NV) {\n        double acc[M][NV] = {};\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < J; ++k) {\n            for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n                const double a = Ap[(i0 + m) * n + k];\n                for (size_t v = 0; v < NV; ++v) {\n                    acc[m][v] += a * Bt[k * JB + jt + v];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n            for (size_t v = 0; v < NV; ++v) {\n                S[(i0 + m) * JB + jt + v] = acc[m][v];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n#endif\n}\n\n} // namespace\n\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // A is stored in row-major order\n    if (n == 0) {\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    double* const __restrict Ap = A.data();\n    // Bt[k * JB + jj] = L[J + jj][k]: transposed panel of the active block columns.\n    std::vector<double> BtStore(n * JB, 0.0);\n    // S[i * JB + jj]: partial sum over k < J for element (i, J + jj).\n    std::vector<double> SStore(n * JB, 0.0);\n    double* const __restrict Bt = BtStore.data();\n    double* const __restrict S = SStore.data();\n\n    bool ok = true;\n\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        for (size_t J = 0; J < n; J += JB) {\n            const size_t jb = std::min(JB, n - J);\n            const size_t jbPad = (jb + NV - 1) / NV * NV;\n\n            // --- Transpose the block-column panel of the already computed part ---\n            #pragma omp for schedule(static) nowait\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < J; ++k) {\n                for (size_t jj = 0; jj < jb; ++jj) {\n                    Bt[k * JB + jj] = Ap[(J + jj) * n + k];\n                }\n                for (size_t jj = jb; jj < jbPad; ++jj) {\n                    Bt[k * JB + jj] = 0.0; // padding lanes must not carry stale data\n                }\n            }\n            #pragma omp barrier\n\n            // --- Panel GEMM: leading part (k < J) of every remaining element ---\n            const size_t nTiles = (n - J + MI - 1) / MI;\n            #pragma omp for schedule(static)\n            for (size_t t = 0; t < nTiles; ++t) {\n                const size_t i0 = J + t * MI;\n                switch (std::min(MI, n - i0)) {\n                    case 6: gemmTile<6>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, J, jbPad); break;\n                    case 5: gemmTile<5>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, J, jbPad); break;\n                    case 4: gemmTile<4>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, J, jbPad); break;\n                    case 3: gemmTile<3>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, J, jbPad); break;\n                    case 2: gemmTile<2>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, J, jbPad); Accumulation runs over increasing k with one\n// accumulator per (i, jj), matching the sequential summation order exactly.\ntemplate <size_t M>\ninline void gemmTile(const double* __restrict Ap, const size_t n, const double* __restrict Bt,\n                     double* __restrict S, const size_t i0, const size_t J, const size_t jbPad) {\n#ifdef CHOLESKY_USE_AVX2\n    for (size_t jt = 0; jt < jbPad; jt += NV) {\n        __m256d acc0[M], acc1[M];\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n            acc0[m] = _mm256_setzero_pd();\n            acc1[m] = _mm256_setzero_pd();\n        }\n        const double* bt = Bt + jt;\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < J; ++k, bt += JB) {\n            const __m256d b0 = _mm256_loadu_pd(bt);\n            const __m256d b1 = _mm256_loadu_pd(bt + 4);\n            for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n                const __m256d a = _mm256_set1_pd(Ap[(i0 + m) * n + k]);\n                acc0[m] = _mm256_fmadd_pd(a, b0, acc0[m]);\n                acc1[m] = _mm256_fmadd_pd(a, b1, acc1[m]);\n            }\n        }\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n            _mm256_storeu_pd(S + (i0 + m) * JB + jt, acc0[m]);\n            _mm256_storeu_pd(S + (i0 + m) * JB + jt + 4, acc1[m]);\n        }\n    }\n#else\n    for (size_t jt = 0; jt < jbPad; jt += NV) {\n        double acc[M][NV] = {};\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < J; ++k) {\n            for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n                const double a = Ap[(i0 + m) * n + k];\n                for (size_t v = 0; v < NV; ++v) {\n                    acc[m][v] += a * Bt[k * JB + jt + v];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n            for (size_t v = 0; v < NV; ++v) {\n                S[(i0 + m) * JB + jt + v] = acc[m][v];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n#endif\n}","numLines":55,"startLine":90,"totalLines":516}}}

The k range is a\n// cache block of the full [0, J) range and the ranges are visited in increasing\n// order, so every (i, jj) accumulator still sees its k in ascending order -\n// exactly the sequential summation order.\ntemplate <size_t M>\ninline void gemmTile(const double* __restrict Ap, const size_t n, const double* __restrict Bt,\n                     double* __restrict S, const size_t i0, const size_t kBeg, const size_t kEnd,\n                     const size_t jbPad) {\n#ifdef CHOLESKY_USE_AVX2\n    for (size_t jt = 0; jt < jbPad; jt += NV) {\n        __m256d acc0[M], acc1[M];\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n            if (kBeg == 0) {\n                acc0[m] = _mm256_setzero_pd();\n                acc1[m] = _mm256_setzero_pd();\n            } else {\n                acc0[m] = _mm256_loadu_pd(S + (i0 + m) * JB + jt);\n                acc1[m] = _mm256_loadu_pd(S + (i0 + m) * JB + jt + 4);\n            }\n        }\n        const double* bt = Bt + kBeg * JB + jt;\n        for (size_t k = kBeg; k < kEnd; ++k, bt += JB) {\n            const __m256d b0 = _mm256_loadu_pd(bt);\n            const __m256d b1 = _mm256_loadu_pd(bt + 4);\n            for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n                const __m256d a = _mm256_set1_pd(Ap[(i0 + m) * n + k]);\n                acc0[m] = _mm256_fmadd_pd(a, b0, acc0[m]);\n                acc1[m] = _mm256_fmadd_pd(a, b1, acc1[m]);\n            }\n        }\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n            _mm256_storeu_pd(S + (i0 + m) * JB + jt, acc0[m]);\n            _mm256_storeu_pd(S + (i0 + m) * JB + jt + 4, acc1[m]);\n        }\n    }\n#else\n    for (size_t jt = 0; jt < jbPad; jt += NV) {\n        double acc[M][NV];\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n            for (size_t v = 0; v < NV; ++v) {\n                acc[m][v] = (kBeg == 0) ? 0.0 : S[(i0 + m) * JB + jt + v];\n            }\n        }\n        for (size_t k = kBeg; k < kEnd; ++k) {\n            for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n                const double a = Ap[(i0 + m) * n + k];\n                for (size_t v = 0; v < NV; ++v) {\n                    acc[m][v] += a * Bt[k * JB + jt + v];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n            for (size_t v = 0; v < NV; ++v) {\n                S[(i0 + m) * JB + jt + v] = acc[m][v];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n#endif\n}\n\n// Dispatches a row tile of runtime height (1..MI) to the register kernel.\ninline void gemmTileDispatch(const double* __restrict Ap, const size_t n, const double* __restrict Bt,\n                             double* __restrict S, const size_t i0, const size_t rows, const size_t kBeg,\n                             const size_t kEnd, const size_t jbPad) {\n    switch (rows) {\n        case 6: gemmTile<6>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, kBeg, kEnd, jbPad); break;\n        case 5: gemmTile<5>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, kBeg, kEnd, jbPad); break;\n        case 4: gemmTile<4>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, kBeg, kEnd, jbPad); break;\n        case 3: gemmTile<3>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, kBeg, kEnd, jbPad); break;\n        case 2: gemmTile<2>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, kBeg, kEnd, jbPad); break;\n        default: gemmTile<1>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, kBeg, kEnd, jbPad); break;\n    }\n}"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1346,"cache_read_input_tokens":99297,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1346},"output_tokens":20,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"efb50a90-2147-4834-a3ac-7d5787197574","uuid":"5a99b2f0-4f0a-4d6d-9ba8-8895a65c22ec","timestamp":"2026-09-06T19:53:15.881Z","request_id":"req_011CenmczVC33m3kyNHGBu6s"}

jt < jbPad; jt += NV) {\n        __m256d acc0[M], acc1[M];\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n            if (kBeg == 0) {\n                acc0[m] = _mm256_setzero_pd();\n                acc1[m] = _mm256_setzero_pd();\n            } else {\n                acc0[m] = _mm256_loadu_pd(S + (i0 + m) * JB + jt);\n                acc1[m] = _mm256_loadu_pd(S + (i0 + m) * JB + jt + 4);\n            }\n        }\n        const double* bt = Bt + kBeg * JB + jt;\n        for (size_t k = kBeg; k < kEnd; ++k, bt += JB) {\n            const __m256d b0 = _mm256_loadu_pd(bt);\n            const __m256d b1 = _mm256_loadu_pd(bt + 4);\n            for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n                const __m256d a = _mm256_set1_pd(Ap[(i0 + m) * n + k]);\n                acc0[m] = _mm256_fmadd_pd(a, b0, acc0[m]);\n                acc1[m] = _mm256_fmadd_pd(a, b1, acc1[m]);\n            }\n        }\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n            _mm256_storeu_pd(S + (i0 + m) * JB + jt, acc0[m]);\n            _mm256_storeu_pd(S + (i0 + m) * JB + jt + 4, acc1[m]);\n        }\n    }\n#else\n    for (size_t jt = 0; jt < jbPad; jt += NV) {\n        double acc[M][NV];\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n            for (size_t v = 0; v < NV; ++v) {\n                acc[m][v] = (kBeg == 0) ? 0.0 : S[(i0 + m) * JB + jt + v];\n            }\n        }\n        for (size_t k = kBeg; k < kEnd; ++k) {\n            for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n                const double a = Ap[(i0 + m) * n + k];\n                for (size_t v = 0; v < NV; ++v) {\n                    acc[m][v] += a * Bt[k * JB + jt + v];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n            for (size_t v = 0; v < NV; ++v) {\n                S[(i0 + m) * JB + jt + v] = acc[m][v];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n#endif\n}\n\n// Dispatches a row tile of runtime height (1..MI) to the register kernel.\ninline void gemmTileDispatch(const double* __restrict Ap, const size_t n, const double* __restrict Bt,\n                             double* __restrict S, const size_t i0, const size_t rows, const size_t kBeg,\n                             const size_t kEnd, const size_t jbPad) {\n    switch (rows) {\n        case 6: gemmTile<6>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, kBeg, kEnd, jbPad); break;\n        case 5: gemmTile<5>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, kBeg, kEnd, jbPad); break;\n        case 4: gemmTile<4>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, kBeg, kEnd, jbPad); break;\n        case 3: gemmTile<3>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, kBeg, kEnd, jbPad); break;\n        case 2: gemmTile<2>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, kBeg, kEnd, jbPad); break;\n        default: gemmTile<1>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, kBeg, kEnd, jbPad); break;\n    }\n}","originalFile":"#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <omp.h>\n#include <sched.h>\n#include <sys/syscall.h>\n#include <unistd.h>\n\n#if defined(__AVX2__) && defined(__FMA__)\n#include <immintrin.h>\n#define CHOLESKY_USE_AVX2 1\n#endif\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Blocked, OpenMP-parallel Cholesky decomposition (left-looking).\n// Decomposes positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is lower triangular.\n//\n// Every element L[i][j] is still computed as\n//     L[i][j] = (A[i][j] - sum_{k<j} L[i][k]*L[j][k]) / L[j][j]\n// with the summation carried out in strictly increasing k order into a single\n// accumulator, so the results are bit-identical to the sequential version.\n// The sum is only *split* at a block boundary J: the leading part (k < J) is\n// computed by a parallel panel-GEMM into S[][], and the trailing part\n// (J <= k < j) continues to accumulate into that very same value.\n\nnamespace {\n\n// Interleave allocations across all NUMA nodes. The matrix is streamed by every\n// thread during the panel updates, so a single-node placement (the default,\n// since std::vector zero-initializes the storage from one thread) would starve\n// the remote socket. Equivalent to running under `numactl --interleave=all`.\nvoid interleaveMemory() {\n#if defined(__linux__) && defined(SYS_set_mempolicy) && defined(SYS_get_mempolicy)\n    constexpr int MPOL_DEFAULT_MODE = 0;\n    constexpr int MPOL_INTERLEAVE_MODE = 3;\n    constexpr unsigned long MPOL_F_MEMS_ALLOWED_FLAG = 1 << 2;\n    constexpr unsigned long MAX_NODES = 1024;\n\n    int mode = 0;\n    if (syscall(SYS_get_mempolicy, &mode, nullptr, 0UL, nullptr, 0UL) != 0 || mode != MPOL_DEFAULT_MODE) {\n        return; // an explicit policy (e.g. from numactl) is already in effect\n    }\n    std::vector<unsigned long> mask(MAX_NODES / (8 * sizeof(unsigned long)), 0UL);\n    if (syscall(SYS_get_mempolicy, nullptr, mask.data(), MAX_NODES, nullptr, MPOL_F_MEMS_ALLOWED_FLAG) != 0) {\n        return;\n    }\n    syscall(SYS_set_mempolicy, MPOL_INTERLEAVE_MODE, mask.data(), MAX_NODES);\n#endif\n}\n\n// Pin each OpenMP thread to its own CPU. Thread migration between cores (and\n// especially between NUMA nodes) costs an order of magnitude here, and the\n// benchmark is usually launched without OMP_PROC_BIND set. An explicit binding\n// policy from the environment always wins.\nvoid bindThreads() {\n#ifdef __linux__\n    if (omp_get_proc_bind() != omp_proc_bind_false || getenv(\"GOMP_CPU_AFFINITY\") != nullptr) {\n        return;\n    }\n    cpu_set_t allowed;\n    CPU_ZERO(&allowed);\n    if (sched_getaffinity(0, sizeof(allowed), &allowed) != 0) {\n        return;\n    }\n    std::vector<int> cpus;\n    for (int c = 0; c < CPU_SETSIZE; ++c) {\n        if (CPU_ISSET(c, &allowed)) {\n            cpus.push_back(c);\n        }\n    }\n    if (cpus.empty()) {\n        return;\n    }\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        cpu_set_t set;\n        CPU_ZERO(&set);\n        CPU_SET(cpus[static_cast<size_t>(omp_get_thread_num()) % cpus.size()], &set);\n        sched_setaffinity(0, sizeof(set), &set);\n    }\n#endif\n}\n\n#ifndef CHOL_JB\n#define CHOL_JB 64\n#endif\nconstexpr size_t JB = CHOL_JB; // column block width\nconstexpr size_t MI = 6;  // rows handled per GEMM register tile\nconstexpr size_t NV = 8;  // columns handled per GEMM register tile (2 AVX2 vectors)\n\n// Computes S[i][jj] = sum_{k<J} A[i][k] * Bt[k][jj] for M consecutive rows i,\n// where Bt[k][jj] = L[J+jj][k] is the transposed (k-contiguous -> jj-contiguous)\n// panel of the block columns. Accumulation runs over increasing k with one\n// accumulator per (i, jj), matching the sequential summation order exactly.\ntemplate <size_t M>\ninline void gemmTile(const double* __restrict Ap, const size_t n, const double* __restrict Bt,\n                     double* __restrict S, const size_t i0, const size_t J, const size_t jbPad) {\n#ifdef CHOLESKY_USE_AVX2\n    for (size_t jt = 0; jt < jbPad; jt += NV) {\n        __m256d acc0[M], acc1[M];\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n            acc0[m] = _mm256_setzero_pd();\n            acc1[m] = _mm256_setzero_pd();\n        }\n        const double* bt = Bt + jt;\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < J; ++k, bt += JB) {\n            const __m256d b0 = _mm256_loadu_pd(bt);\n            const __m256d b1 = _mm256_loadu_pd(bt + 4);\n            for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n                const __m256d a = _mm256_set1_pd(Ap[(i0 + m) * n + k]);\n                acc0[m] = _mm256_fmadd_pd(a, b0, acc0[m]);\n                acc1[m] = _mm256_fmadd_pd(a, b1, acc1[m]);\n            }\n        }\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n            _mm256_storeu_pd(S + (i0 + m) * JB + jt, acc0[m]);\n            _mm256_storeu_pd(S + (i0 + m) * JB + jt + 4, acc1[m]);\n        }\n    }\n#else\n    for (size_t jt = 0; jt < jbPad; jt += NV) {\n        double acc[M][NV] = {};\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < J; ++k) {\n            for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n                const double a = Ap[(i0 + m) * n + k];\n                for (size_t v = 0; v < NV; ++v) {\n                    acc[m][v] += a * Bt[k * JB + jt + v];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n            for (size_t v = 0; v < NV; ++v) {\n                S[(i0 + m) * JB + jt + v] = acc[m][v];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n#endif\n}\n\n} // namespace\n\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // A is stored in row-major order\n    if (n == 0) {\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    double* const __restrict Ap = A.data();\n    // Bt[k * JB + jj] = L[J + jj][k]: transposed panel of the active block columns.\n    std::vector<double> BtStore(n * JB, 0.0);\n    // S[i * JB + jj]: partial sum over k < J for element (i, J + jj).\n    std::vector<double> SStore(n * JB, 0.0);\n    double* const __restrict Bt = BtStore.data();\n    double* const __restrict S = SStore.data();\n\n    bool ok = true;\n\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        for (size_t J = 0; J < n; J += JB) {\n            const size_t jb = std::min(JB, n - J);\n            const size_t jbPad = (jb + NV - 1) / NV * NV;\n\n            // --- Transpose the block-column panel of the already computed part ---\n            #pragma omp for schedule(static) nowait\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < J; ++k) {\n                for (size_t jj = 0; jj < jb; ++jj) {\n                    Bt[k * JB + jj] = Ap[(J + jj) * n + k];\n                }\n                for (size_t jj = jb; jj < jbPad; ++jj) {\n                    Bt[k * JB + jj] = 0.0; // padding lanes must not carry stale data\n                }\n            }\n            #pragma omp barrier\n\n            // --- Panel GEMM: leading part (k < J) of every remaining element ---\n            const size_t nTiles = (n - J + MI - 1) / MI;\n            #pragma omp for schedule(static)\n            for (size_t t = 0; t < nTiles; ++t) {\n                const size_t i0 = J + t * MI;\n                switch (std::min(MI, n - i0)) {\n                    case 6: gemmTile<6>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, J, jbPad); break;\n                    case 5: gemmTile<5>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, J, jbPad); break;\n                    case 4: gemmTile<4>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, J, jbPad); break;\n                    case 3: gemmTile<3>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, J, jbPad); break;\n                    case 2: gemmTile<2>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, J, jbPad); break;\n                    default: gemmTile<1>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, J, jbPad); break;\n                }\n            }\n            #pragma omp single\n            {\n                // --- Factor the diagonal block sequentially (O(jb^3) work) ---\n                for (size_t j = J; j < J + jb; ++j) {\n                    const double* const Aj = Ap + j * n;\n                    double sum = S[j * JB + (j - J)];\n                    for (size_t k = J; k < j; ++k) {\n                        sum += Aj[k] * Aj[k];\n                    }\n                    const double val = Aj[j] - sum;\n                    if (val <= 0.0) {\n                        // Matrix is not positive definite\n                        printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n                        ok = false;\n                        break;\n                    }\n                    Ap[j * n + j] = sqrt(val);\n\n                    const double djj = Ap[j * n + j];\n                    const size_t jj = j - J;\n                    size_t i = j + 1;\n                    for (; i + 4 <= J + jb; i += 4) { // four independent FMA chains\n                        double* const A0 = Ap + i * n;\n                        double* const A1 = A0 + n;\n                        double* const A2 = A0 + 2 * n;\n                        double* const A3 = A0 + 3 * n;\n                        const double* const Si = S + i * JB + jj;\n                        double s0 = Si[0], s1 = Si[JB], s2 = Si[2 * JB], s3 = Si[3 * JB];\n                        for (size_t k = J; k < j; ++k) {\n                            const double b = Aj[k];\n                            s0 += A0[k] * b;\n                            s1 += A1[k] * b;\n                            s2 += A2[k] * b;\n                            s3 += A3[k] * b;\n                        }\n                        A0[j] = (A0[j] - s0) / djj;\n                        A1[j] = (A1[j] - s1) / djj;\n                        A2[j] = (A2[j] - s2) / djj;\n                        A3[j] = (A3[j] - s3) / djj;\n                    }\n                    for (; i < J + jb; ++i) {\n                        double* const Ai = Ap + i * n;\n                        double s = S[i * JB + jj];\n                        for (size_t k = J; k < j; ++k) {\n                            s += Ai[k] * Aj[k];\n                        }\n                        Ai[j] = (Ai[j] - s) / djj;\n                    }\n                }\n            } // implicit barrier: publishes ok and the diagonal block\n\n            if (!ok) {\n                break;\n            }\n\n            // --- Triangular solve for the rows below the diagonal block ---\n            const size_t iStart = J + jb;\n            const size_t nQuads = (n - iStart) / 4;\n            #pragma omp for schedule(static)\n            for (size_t q = 0; q < nQuads; ++q) {\n                const size_t i0 = iStart + q * 4;\n                double* const A0 = Ap + i0 * n;\n                double* const A1 = A0 + n;\n                double* const A2 = A0 + 2 * n;\n                double* const A3 = A0 + 3 * n;\n                const double* const S0 = S + i0 * JB;\n                for (size_t j = J; j < J + jb; ++j) {\n                    const double* const Aj = Ap + j * n;\n                    const size_t jj = j - J;\n                    double s0 = S0[jj];\n                    double s1 = S0[JB + jj];\n                    double s2 = S0[2 * JB + jj];\n                    double s3 = S0[3 * JB + jj];\n                    for (size_t k = J; k < j; ++k) {\n                        const double b = Aj[k];\n                        s0 += A0[k] * b;\n                        s1 += A1[k] * b;\n                        s2 += A2[k] * b;\n                        s3 += A3[k] * b;\n                    }\n                    const double djj = Aj[j];\n                    A0[j] = (A0[j] - s0) / djj;\n                    A1[j] = (A1[j] - s1) / djj;\n                    A2[j] = (A2[j] - s2) / djj;\n                    A3[j] = (A3[j] - s3) / djj;\n                }\n            }\n            #pragma omp for schedule(static)\n            for (size_t i = iStart + nQuads * 4; i < n; ++i) {\n                double* const Ai = Ap + i * n;\n                for (size_t j = J; j < J + jb; ++j) {\n                    const double* const Aj = Ap + j * n;\n                    double s = S[i * JB + (j - J)];\n                    for (size_t k = J; k < j; ++k) {\n                        s += Ai[k] * Aj[k];\n                    }\n                    Ai[j] = (Ai[j] - s) / Aj[j];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // --- Zero out upper triangular part ---\n        if (ok) {\n            #pragma omp for schedule(static)\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n                for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n                    Ap[i * n + j] = 0.0;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return ok;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n    \n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    \n    // Generate random matrix B\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n    \n    // Compute A = B * B^T (rows are independent; the k-order of every dot\n    // product is preserved, so the generated matrix is bit-identical)\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        const double* const Bi = B.data() + i * n;\n        double* const Ai = A.data() + i * n;\n        size_t j = 0;\n        for (; j + 4 <= n; j += 4) {\n            const double* const B0 = B.data() + j * n;\n            double s0 = 0.0, s1 = 0.0, s2 = 0.0, s3 = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                const double a = Bi[k];\n                s0 += a * B0[k];\n                s1 += a * B0[n + k];\n                s2 += a * B0[2 * n + k];\n                s3 += a * B0[3 * n + k];\n            }\n            Ai[j] = s0;\n            Ai[j + 1] = s1;\n            Ai[j + 2] = s2;\n            Ai[j + 3] = s3;\n        }\n        for (; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += Bi[k] * B[j * n + k];\n            }\n            Ai[j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i * n + i] += n;\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig, const size_t n) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n    \n    std::vector<double> reconstructed(n * n);\n\n    // Compute L * L^T\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        const double* const Li = L.data() + i * n;\n        double* const Ri = reconstructed.data() + i * n;\n        size_t j = 0;\n        for (; j + 4 <= n; j += 4) {\n            const double* const L0 = L.data() + j * n;\n            double s0 = 0.0, s1 = 0.0, s2 = 0.0, s3 = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                const double a = Li[k];\n                s0 += a * L0[k];\n                s1 += a * L0[n + k];\n                s2 += a * L0[2 * n + k];\n                s3 += a * L0[3 * n + k];\n            }\n            Ri[j] = s0;\n            Ri[j + 1] = s1;\n            Ri[j + 2] = s2;\n            Ri[j + 3] = s3;\n        }\n        for (; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += Li[k] * L[j * n + k];\n            }\n            Ri[j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Compare with original\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(max : maxError, relError)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        const double error = fabs(reconstructed[i] - A_orig[i]);\n        maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n\n        const double rel = error / (fabs(A_orig[i]) + 1e-10);\n        relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n    printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n    \n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    interleaveMemory();\n    bindThreads();\n\n    printf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", n, n);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    // Allocate matrix\n    std::vector<double> A(n * n);\n    std::vector<double> A_orig;\n    \n    // Generate positive definite matrix\n    printf(\"Generating positive definite matrix...\\n\");\n    generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(A, n);\n    \n    if (validate) {\n        A_orig = A; The\n// sum is only *split* at a block boundary J: the leading part (k < J) is\n// computed by a parallel panel-GEMM into S[][], and the trailing part\n// (J <= k < j) continues to accumulate into that very same value. Results\n// therefore differ from the sequential code only by the last-bit effects of\n// fused multiply-add (the kernels here always fuse, whereas the auto-vectorized\n// scalar loop fuses only part of its iterations).\n\nnamespace {\n\n// Interleave allocations across all NUMA nodes. The matrix is streamed by every\n// thread during the panel updates, so a single-node placement (the default,\n// since std::vector zero-initializes the storage from one thread) would starve\n// the remote socket. Equivalent to running under `numactl --interleave=all`.\nvoid interleaveMemory() {\n#if defined(__linux__) && defined(SYS_set_mempolicy) && defined(SYS_get_mempolicy)\n    constexpr int MPOL_DEFAULT_MODE = 0;\n    constexpr int MPOL_INTERLEAVE_MODE = 3;\n    constexpr unsigned long MPOL_F_MEMS_ALLOWED_FLAG = 1 << 2;\n    constexpr unsigned long MAX_NODES = 1024;\n\n    int mode = 0;\n    if (syscall(SYS_get_mempolicy, &mode, nullptr, 0UL, nullptr, 0UL) != 0 || mode != MPOL_DEFAULT_MODE) {\n        return; // an explicit policy (e.g. from numactl) is already in effect\n    }\n    std::vector<unsigned long> mask(MAX_NODES / (8 * sizeof(unsigned long)), 0UL);\n    if (syscall(SYS_get_mempolicy, nullptr, mask.data(), MAX_NODES, nullptr, MPOL_F_MEMS_ALLOWED_FLAG) != 0) {\n        return;\n    }\n    syscall(SYS_set_mempolicy, MPOL_INTERLEAVE_MODE, mask.data(), MAX_NODES);\n#endif\n}\n\n// Pin each OpenMP thread to its own CPU. Thread migration between cores (and\n// especially between NUMA nodes) costs an order of magnitude here, and the\n// benchmark is usually launched without OMP_PROC_BIND set. An explicit binding\n// policy from the environment always wins.\nvoid bindThreads() {\n#ifdef __linux__\n    if (omp_get_proc_bind() != omp_proc_bind_false || getenv(\"GOMP_CPU_AFFINITY\") != nullptr) {\n        return;\n    }\n    cpu_set_t allowed;\n    CPU_ZERO(&allowed);\n    if (sched_getaffinity(0, sizeof(allowed), &allowed) != 0) {\n        return;\n    }\n    std::vector<int> cpus;\n    for (int c = 0; c < CPU_SETSIZE; ++c) {\n        if (CPU_ISSET(c, &allowed)) {\n            cpus.push_back(c);\n        }\n    }\n    if (cpus.empty()) {\n        return;\n    }\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        cpu_set_t set;\n        CPU_ZERO(&set);\n        CPU_SET(cpus[static_cast<size_t>(omp_get_thread_num()) % cpus.size()], &set);\n        sched_setaffinity(0, sizeof(set), &set);\n    }\n#endif\n}\n\nconstexpr size_t JB = 32;  // column block width\nconstexpr size_t KC = 128; // k cache block of the panel update\nconstexpr size_t MI = 6;   // rows handled per GEMM register tile\nconstexpr size_t NV = 8;   // columns handled per GEMM register tile (2 AVX2 vectors)\n\n// Accumulates S[i][jj] += sum_{kBeg <= k < kEnd} A[i][k] * Bt[k][jj] for M\n// consecutive rows i, where Bt[k][jj] = L[J+jj][k] is the transposed\n// (k-contiguous -> jj-contiguous) panel of the block columns. The k range is a\n// cache block of the full [0, J) range and the ranges are visited in increasing\n// order, so every (i, jj) accumulator still sees its k in ascending order -\n// exactly the sequential summation order.\ntemplate <size_t M>\ninline void gemmTile(const double* __restrict Ap, const size_t n, const double* __restrict Bt,\n                     double* __restrict S, const size_t i0, const size_t kBeg, const size_t kEnd,\n                     const size_t jbPad) {\n#ifdef CHOLESKY_USE_AVX2\n    for (size_t jt = 0; jt < jbPad; jt += NV) {\n        __m256d acc0[M], acc1[M];\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n            if (kBeg == 0) {\n                acc0[m] = _mm256_setzero_pd();\n                acc1[m] = _mm256_setzero_pd();\n            } else {\n                acc0[m] = _mm256_loadu_pd(S + (i0 + m) * JB + jt);\n                acc1[m] = _mm256_loadu_pd(S + (i0 + m) * JB + jt + 4);\n            }\n        }\n        const double* bt = Bt + kBeg * JB + jt;\n        for (size_t k = kBeg; k < kEnd; ++k, bt += JB) {\n            const __m256d b0 = _mm256_loadu_pd(bt);\n            const __m256d b1 = _mm256_loadu_pd(bt + 4);\n            for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n                const __m256d a = _mm256_set1_pd(Ap[(i0 + m) * n + k]);\n                acc0[m] = _mm256_fmadd_pd(a, b0, acc0[m]);\n                acc1[m] = _mm256_fmadd_pd(a, b1, acc1[m]);\n            }\n        }\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n            _mm256_storeu_pd(S + (i0 + m) * JB + jt, acc0[m]);\n            _mm256_storeu_pd(S + (i0 + m) * JB + jt + 4, acc1[m]);\n        }\n    }\n#else\n    for (size_t jt = 0; jt < jbPad; jt += NV) {\n        double acc[M][NV];\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n            for (size_t v = 0; v < NV; ++v) {\n                acc[m][v] = (kBeg == 0) ? 0.0 : S[(i0 + m) * JB + jt + v];\n            }\n        }\n        for (size_t k = kBeg; k < kEnd; ++k) {\n            for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n                const double a = Ap[(i0 + m) * n + k];\n                for (size_t v = 0; v < NV; ++v) {\n                    acc[m][v] += a * Bt[k * JB + jt + v];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        for (size_t m = 0; m < M; ++m) {\n            for (size_t v = 0; v < NV; ++v) {\n                S[(i0 + m) * JB + jt + v] = acc[m][v];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n#endif\n}\n\n// Dispatches a row tile of runtime height (1..MI) to the register kernel.\ninline void gemmTileDispatch(const double* __restrict Ap, const size_t n, const double* __restrict Bt,\n                             double* __restrict S, const size_t i0, const size_t rows, const size_t kBeg,\n                             const size_t kEnd, const size_t jbPad) {\n    switch (rows) {\n        case 6: gemmTile<6>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, kBeg, kEnd, jbPad); break;\n        case 5: gemmTile<5>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, kBeg, kEnd, jbPad); break;\n        case 4: gemmTile<4>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, kBeg, kEnd, jbPad); break;\n        case 3: gemmTile<3>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, kBeg, kEnd, jbPad); break;\n        case 2: gemmTile<2>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, kBeg, kEnd, jbPad); break;\n        default: gemmTile<1>(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, kBeg, kEnd, jbPad); break;\n    }\n}\n\n} // namespace\n\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // A is stored in row-major order\n    if (n == 0) {\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    double* const __restrict Ap = A.data();\n    // Bt[k * JB + jj] = L[J + jj][k]: transposed panel of the active block columns.\n    std::vector<double> BtStore(n * JB, 0.0);\n    // S[i * JB + jj]: partial sum over k < J for element (i, J + jj).\n    std::vector<double> SStore(n * JB, 0.0);\n    double* const __restrict Bt = BtStore.data();\n    double* const __restrict S = SStore.data();\n\n    bool ok = true;\n\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        const int tid = omp_get_thread_num();\n        const int nThreads = omp_get_num_threads();\n\n        for (size_t J = 0; J < n; J += JB) {\n            const size_t jb = std::min(JB, n - J);\n            const size_t jbPad = (jb + NV - 1) / NV * NV;\n\n            // --- Transpose the block-column panel of the already computed part ---\n            #pragma omp for schedule(static) nowait\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < J; ++k) {\n                for (size_t jj = 0; jj < jb; ++jj) {\n                    Bt[k * JB + jj] = Ap[(J + jj) * n + k];\n                }\n                for (size_t jj = jb; jj < jbPad; ++jj) {\n                    Bt[k * JB + jj] = 0.0; // padding lanes must not carry stale data\n                }\n            }\n            #pragma omp barrier\n\n            // --- Panel GEMM: leading part (k < J) of every remaining element ---\n            // Row tiles are distributed statically, and each thread walks its own\n            // tiles inside a k cache block, so no synchronization is needed between\n            // the k blocks: the transposed panel slice stays hot in L2 while the\n            // rows of A are fetched from memory only once per block.\n            const size_t nTiles = (n - J + MI - 1) / MI;\n            const size_t tLo = nTiles * static_cast<size_t>(tid) / static_cast<size_t>(nThreads);\n            const size_t tHi = nTiles * static_cast<size_t>(tid + 1) / static_cast<size_t>(nThreads);\n            for (size_t kBeg = 0; kBeg < J || kBeg == 0; kBeg += KC) {\n                const size_t kEnd = std::min(kBeg + KC, J);\n                for (size_t t = tLo; t < tHi; ++t) {\n                    const size_t i0 = J + t * MI;\n                    gemmTileDispatch(Ap, n, Bt, S, i0, std::min(MI, n - i0), kBeg, kEnd, jbPad);\n                }\n                if (kEnd >= J) {\n                    break;\n                }\n            }\n            #pragma omp barrier\n            #pragma omp single\n            {\n                // --- Factor the diagonal block sequentially (O(jb^3) work) ---\n                for (size_t j = J; j < J + jb; ++j) {\n                    const double* const Aj = Ap + j * n;\n                    double sum = S[j * JB + (j - J)];\n                    for (size_t k = J; k < j; ++k) {\n                        sum += Aj[k] * Aj[k];\n                    }\n                    const double val = Aj[j] - sum;\n                    if (val <= 0.0) {\n                        // Matrix is not positive definite\n                        printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n                        ok = false;\n                        break;\n                    }\n                    Ap[j * n + j] = sqrt(val);\n\n                    const double djj = Ap[j * n + j];\n                    const size_t jj = j - J;\n                    size_t i = j + 1;\n                    for (; i + 4 <= J + jb; i += 4) { // four independent FMA chains\n                        double* const A0 = Ap + i * n;\n                        double* const A1 = A0 + n;\n                        double* const A2 = A0 + 2 * n;\n                        double* const A3 = A0 + 3 * n;\n                        const double* const Si = S + i * JB + jj;\n                        double s0 = Si[0], s1 = Si[JB], s2 = Si[2 * JB], s3 = Si[3 * JB];\n                        for (size_t k = J; k < j; ++k) {\n                            const double b = Aj[k];\n                            s0 += A0[k] * b;\n                            s1 += A1[k] * b;\n                            s2 += A2[k] * b;\n                            s3 += A3[k] * b;\n                        }\n                        A0[j] = (A0[j] - s0) / djj;\n                        A1[j] = (A1[j] - s1) / djj;\n                        A2[j] = (A2[j] - s2) / djj;\n                        A3[j] = (A3[j] - s3) / djj;\n                    }\n                    for (; i < J + jb; ++i) {\n                        double* const Ai = Ap + i * n;\n                        double s = S[i * JB + jj];\n                        for (size_t k = J; k < j; ++k) {\n                            s += Ai[k] * Aj[k];\n                        }\n                        Ai[j] = (Ai[j] - s) / djj;\n                    }\n                }\n            } // implicit barrier: publishes ok and the diagonal block\n\n            if (!ok) {\n                break;\n            }\n\n            // --- Triangular solve for the rows below the diagonal block ---\n            const size_t iStart = J + jb;\n            const size_t nQuads = (n - iStart) / 4;\n            #pragma omp for schedule(static) nowait\n            for (size_t q = 0; q < nQuads; ++q) {\n                const size_t i0 = iStart + q * 4;\n                double* const A0 = Ap + i0 * n;\n                double* const A1 = A0 + n;\n                double* const A2 = A0 + 2 * n;\n                double* const A3 = A0 + 3 * n;\n                const double* const S0 = S + i0 * JB;\n                for (size_t j = J; j < J + jb; ++j) {\n                    const double* const Aj = Ap + j * n;\n                    const size_t jj = j - J;\n                    double s0 = S0[jj];\n                    double s1 = S0[JB + jj];\n                    double s2 = S0[2 * JB + jj];\n                    double s3 = S0[3 * JB + jj];\n                    for (size_t k = J;
